name: Mary's Looking Glass
summary: In Duskwood, Mary’s discarded looking glass passes from a ghoul to a stargazer.

sections.title: A Forsaken Treasure
sections.body: Blind Mary once treasured the polished mirror. After her death and the loss of her eyes, her reflection became an agonizing reminder of what she had lost. She cast the looking glass away behind her barn, where Duskwood's gloom closed in. An Insane Ghoul found it among the ruined outskirts and carried it south to the crypts of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

sections.title: Eyes to the Heavens
sections.body: In Darkshire, the stargazer Viktori Prism'Antras dreams of seeing through Duskwood's eternal twilight to the clear heavens above. His telescope needs special optical lenses and reflective glass. Mary sends adventurers after the feral undead in the cemetery's ruined chapel to recover her looking glass. Viktori needs it as a reflector in his machine for viewing the stars.

faq.q: Why did Mary throw the looking glass away?
faq.answer: The looking glass was once one of Mary's finest treasures, but she threw it behind the barn after an incident she does not fully describe. In another encounter, she explains that she tore out her own eyes because she could not bear her appearance.

faq.q: Who ended up with the mirror after Mary discarded it?
faq.answer: An Insane Ghoul roaming the woods behind Mary's old farmstead scavenged the discarded mirror. The undead creature eventually took up residence in the abandoned chapel at Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

faq.q: Why does Viktori Prism'Antras want Mary's looking glass?
faq.answer: Viktori is building an elaborate telescope to pierce Duskwood's gloom and study the stars. He needs a fine reflective surface to direct light through the device, and Mary's glass fits his design.

faq.q: Where can the Insane Ghoul holding the mirror be found?
faq.answer: The Insane Ghoul lurks in Duskwood's far southeastern corner, haunting the ruined stone chapel in Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

angles.text: Engineers can appreciate how Viktori repurposes an antique household mirror as an optical reflector for a device to view the stars.
Recovering relics from the horrors in Tranquil Gardens Cemetery brings some closure to Darkshire's troubled citizens and aids the town's projects.
